authorship: Hand-authored adapter selection and bound witnesses over docs/A1_RECOVERY_CONTRACT.md section 3. No production persistence code exists or was consulted.

cases.title: A usable IndexedDB probe selects the primary adapter
A failed IndexedDB probe falls back to bounded localStorage

expected.law: The fallback engages only after the primary capability probe fails, never by preference.

cases.title: Both probes failing selects none and points to Export
The localStorage envelope bound is exactly one million bytes

expected.law: The bound is inclusive; one byte over refuses without truncation.

cases.title: The IndexedDB envelope bound is exactly eight million bytes

expected.law: An adapter exposes probe/read/writeCurrentWithRotation/remove only; scheduling, checksums, rotation policy, and status belong to the service. A port with extra behavior is a contract violation.

cases.title: Adapter transitions are logged without chart text

expected.forbiddenInLogs: chart text or any user-authored string
expected.law: Logs carry identity and integrity data only.
Every key begins with the envelope schema prefix and stays within the bound.
